For decades, the most powerful organizations in the world had the same problem. Too much data and no way to make sense of it. Then one company found a solution.

While the world was focused on Google, Microsoft, and OpenAI, Palantir quietly became the operating system behind governments, militaries, hospitals, and critical infrastructure across the West. Its software helps track patients, manage supply chains, coordinate military operations, and turn mountains of disconnected information into real-time decisions.

Most people think Palantir is a data company. It isn't. Palantir doesn't want to collect your data, it wants to organize reality itself.
